name: extra-roslogs
argv:
set -e; source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source /driver_work/install/setup.bash; if test -f /main-install/setup.bash; then source /main-install/setup.bash; fi; unset ROS_STATIC_PEERS ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE FASTDDS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE CYCLONEDDS_URI; export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=171 RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_fastrtps_cpp ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE=LOCALHOST PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ROS_LOG_DIR=/review/roslogs XML_CATALOG_FILES=/acceptance-tools/offline-schema/catalog.xml GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=/main-source; cd /main-source; python3 - <<'INNER'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil,datetime,json
out=Path('/review/extra-roslogs');out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
cutoff=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat('2026-10-13T05:07:30+00:00').timestamp();items=[]
for base in [Path('/tmp/mtc_phase2a_test_logs'),Path('/tmp/mtc_phase2b_tests')]:
 for p in base.rglob('*'):
  if p.is_file() and p.stat().st_mtime >= cutoff:
   q=out/base.name/p.relative_to(base);q.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(p,q);items.append(str(p))
(out/'collection.json').write_text(json.dumps({'cutoff':cutoff,'files':items},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Additional current-container ROS logs',len(items))
INNER
